Confirmatory diagnosis – Correlate a compatible clinical picture (pain, motor/sensory/autonomic deficits, sensory level) with imaging that demonstrates compression of the cord or cauda equina.
Anatomical hierarchy (cortex → basal ganglia → cerebellum → brain stem → spinal cord → nerve root → plexus → cauda equina → nerve → neuromuscular junction → muscle)
